child.label: Entertainment predictions
child.description: Questions about predicting future events in film, TV, music and video games, such as box office results, awards, release dates and industry trends.
child.not_for: Predictions about sports, esports or athletes go to Sports predictions.
examples: Will an animated film win the Oscar for Best Picture?
Will streaming services replace traditional TV channels?
